blurb: Vine 49 offers immersive wine tours celebrating wineries, breweries, and restaurants of the Okanagan Valley with local expert guides. Tours include tasting fees, bottled water, and complimentary pick-up and drop off. They provide a modern and luxurious fleet for comfort and style.
